data.narrative:
LanzaTech is a public-stage Climate & Energy company founded by Sean Simpson and Richard Forster that has raised over $500M to date. The target currently trades at a $72.51M market valuation. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 9 total peers—1 public and 8 private—within the same sector and stage, including QuantumScape, Enovix, and Solid Power.

The peer-median method was applied using three same-sector, same-stage public comparables. The median valuation across QuantumScape ($3.6B), Enovix ($1.0B), and Solid Power ($504M) yields $1.0B, with a range spanning $504M to $3.6B. This method is the primary quantitative anchor available in the dataset.

The triangulated valuation range is $850M to $1.1B, centered on a median of $1.0B. This range reflects the peer-median approach; however, the analysis is constrained by reliance on a single method with only three comparables, introducing material uncertainty around the appropriate multiple. The current market price of $72.51M sits substantially below the indicated range, suggesting either market undervaluation or material concerns not captured in peer benchmarking. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the selected comps, sector-specific capital intensity, and path to profitability relative to peers.
